tools.name: aletheore_add_custom_skill
tools.description: Saves a local custom skill under the given name, so it can later be fetched via aletheore_get_skill('custom/<name>') and shows up in aletheore_list_skills.

tools.name: aletheore_answer
tools.description: Answer a natural-language question about this repository from the semantic index.

tools.name: aletheore_ask
tools.description: One entry point for code evidence.

tools.name: aletheore_ast_pattern
tools.description: Structural search: find code by shape rather than by words, via a raw tree-sitter S-expression query: e.g. functions that catch a specific exception type, or classes implementing a given interface, regardless of naming.

tools.name: aletheore_branch
tools.description: Git branch metadata (head commit, tracking info).

tools.name: aletheore_changes
tools.description: What changed between the two most recent scans of this repo.

tools.name: aletheore_cluster
tools.description: The architecture cluster containing this module.

tools.name: aletheore_database
tools.description: Detected database usage: ORMs, connection strings, migrations.

tools.name: aletheore_dead_code
tools.description: Candidates for unreferenced functions/classes and unused dependencies; verify runtime usage.

tools.name: aletheore_endpoints
tools.description: All API endpoints mapped from source.

tools.name: aletheore_environment_variables
tools.description: Environment variables referenced in the codebase.

tools.name: aletheore_error_handling
tools.description: Where the code defines, raises and catches errors: error types, raise or throw sites and catch handlers (file and line), plus per-type counts.

tools.name: aletheore_find_evidence_for_dependency
tools.description: Resolve a dependency or import to source evidence.

tools.name: aletheore_find_evidence_for_endpoint
tools.description: Resolve an API endpoint to source evidence: file, line, symbol, owner, commit, dependency, and risk.

tools.name: aletheore_find_evidence_for_symbol
tools.description: Resolve a function or class symbol to source evidence.

tools.name: aletheore_find_skill
tools.description: Finds the right Hallbook skill in one call, or says to move on.

tools.name: aletheore_get_blast_radius
tools.description: Resolved import dependents of target (a file path), not a guarantee of every runtime impact: one call instead of manually chasing aletheore_imported_by recursively.

tools.name: aletheore_get_skill
tools.description: Fetches one skill by its skill_id (from aletheore_search_skills or aletheore_list_skills): its title, description, license, copyright holder, source_url (the pinned upstream), what it requires of the agent (e.g. subagents, an MCP server, a browser), and the full instructions in content.

tools.name: aletheore_get_skill_file
tools.description: Fetches one companion file of a bundled skill (a reference document, script, template or data file) by its path relative to the skill, as listed in the files field of aletheore_get_skill.

tools.name: aletheore_healthcheck
tools.description: GET-only live health check of mapped API endpoints against a running instance.

tools.name: aletheore_hotspots
tools.description: Files with the most git churn/co-change activity.

tools.name: aletheore_imported_by
tools.description: Which modules import this one.

tools.name: aletheore_imports
tools.description: This module's own list of imports.

tools.name: aletheore_index
tools.description: Build the semantic search index for this repo's evidence, required before aletheore_search_codebase or aletheore_answer can be used.

tools.name: aletheore_infrastructure
tools.description: Detected infrastructure config: Docker, CI, IaC files.

tools.name: aletheore_layer_violations
tools.description: Layer-convention violations detected in the architecture.

tools.name: aletheore_licenses
tools.description: All dependency license findings for this repo.

tools.name: aletheore_list
tools.description: Lists the valid names/identifiers for one evidence collection, so other tools' exact-match target arguments can be filled in correctly.

tools.name: aletheore_list_skills
tools.description: Browses Hallbook.

tools.name: aletheore_locate
tools.description: Find where something is defined and see the code, in one call.

tools.name: aletheore_managed_audit
tools.description: Run a full audit report using Aletheore's managed audit service.

tools.name: aletheore_neighborhood
tools.description: A module's imports, dependents, and cluster in one call.

tools.name: aletheore_overview
tools.description: A repo-level summary: languages, frameworks, monorepo structure, dependency-graph size, module/cluster counts, and git age/commit cadence/branch count.

tools.name: aletheore_ownership
tools.description: Code ownership derived from git blame history.

tools.name: aletheore_remove_custom_skill
tools.description: Deletes a custom skill by name: the local file (a <name>.md.deleted-<time>.bak copy is kept next to it) and, when signed in, the copy on your account, which is removed for every machine.

tools.name: aletheore_scan
tools.description: Run the deterministic Aletheore scanner and save evidence for this repository.

tools.name: aletheore_search
tools.description: Deterministic literal or regex search over the repository's source files.

tools.name: aletheore_search_codebase
tools.description: Hybrid search (meaning + exact identifiers) over the repository's indexed code.

tools.name: aletheore_search_skills
tools.description: Searches Hallbook, Aletheore's library of vetted agent skills (over a thousand bundled skills plus your own custom ones), by what you are about to do, e.g. 'flaky test', 'stripe webhooks', 'write a plan', 'review a pull request for security'.

tools.name: aletheore_secrets
tools.description: Secret-scanner findings for one file.

tools.name: aletheore_static_analysis
tools.description: Static analysis findings (SonarQube/Semgrep/Bearer/gosec/Bandit/Joern/Trivy/PMD), normalized into one shape: {tool, rule_id, severity, type, path, line, message}.

tools.name: aletheore_symbol_path
tools.description: Is there an evidence-backed path from source_symbol (defined in source) to target_symbol (defined in target)? Built from real imports edges and real file content, not a full symbol-level call graph: this scanner doesn't record per-call-site edges between arbitrary symbols, so confirmed is only ever True for the two cases with real content to check: same file, or a direct 1-hop import.

tools.name: aletheore_symbol_source
tools.description: Exact source text for one named function/class, with resolved line bounds.

tools.name: aletheore_symbols
tools.description: This module's extracted functions and classes.

tools.name: aletheore_verify_citations
tools.description: Checks every file:line citation in report_text against this repo's real evidence and real file line counts.

tools.name: aletheore_vulnerabilities
tools.description: All dependency vulnerability findings for this repo.
